text: A coupling capacitor blocks a DC OFFSET, not hum: mains hum is 50/60 Hz AC and passes through. Never call hum DC.

said "Step three: specialized white blood cells become memory cells, storing the exact shape of that antibody." but Memory cells do not store the shape of the antibody; they store the genetic information required to produce those specific antibodies upon re-exposure to the antigen.

said "Step three: each cone cell absorbs a different wavelength from the red apple, sending nerve signals to your brain." but A red apple reflects mostly long wavelengths; these stimulate your long-wavelength (red) cones significantly, while medium and short-wavelength cones are stimulated less.
